summary: Authorize native landing admission and reserve existing host headroom

replay.detail: Existing membership classes and custody records remain readable; granted custody is retained.

schema.detail: Finite host policy adds landing.allowedActors, landing.memoryBytes and landing.heavyIoSlots with empty/zero defaults. Shell execution and terminal receipts add optional typed refusal codes and receipt refusal reasons.

rules.detail: Landing requires host-authorized native ownership and strict FIFO. Ordinary work and seats cannot consume unused landing headroom; total host memory and IO capacity do not grow.

compatibility.detail: An unconfigured host visibly refuses landing with unauthorized-landing. Ordinary admission retains its existing capacity when reservations are zero. Declared priority remains metadata.

downtime.detail: No automatic restart or host activation.

manual.detail: Deploy the supporting daemon before setting the new deny-unknown-fields host policy keys. Configure exact authorized actor subjects and a carve-out of existing host totals.

recovery.detail: Existing generation fencing and confirmed-retirement custody rules remain unchanged.
